diff --git a/src/main/kotlin/kotlinx/coroutines/Delay.kt b/src/main/kotlin/kotlinx/coroutines/Delay.kt
index 61b674e..7b1f0c5 100644
--- a/src/main/kotlin/kotlinx/coroutines/Delay.kt
+++ b/src/main/kotlin/kotlinx/coroutines/Delay.kt
@@ -5,10 +5,15 @@
 package kotlinx.coroutines
 
 import kotlin.time.Duration
+import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.milliseconds
 
 /**
- * Convert this duration to its millisecond value.
- * Positive durations are coerced at least `1`.
+ * Round positive finite durations up to the smallest covering whole millisecond.
+ * Nonpositive durations yield zero; positive infinity yields [Long.MAX_VALUE].
  */
-internal fun Duration.toDelayMillis(): Long =
-    if (this > Duration.ZERO) inWholeMilliseconds.coerceAtLeast(1) else 0
+internal fun Duration.toDelayMillis(): Long {
+    if (this <= Duration.ZERO) return 0
+    if (this == Duration.INFINITE) return Long.MAX_VALUE
+    val wholeMillis = inWholeMilliseconds
+    return if (this > wholeMillis.milliseconds) wholeMillis + 1 else wholeMillis
+}

 /**

-internal fun Duration.toDelayMillis(): Long =
